name: band-of-burning-verdict-play-without-tamer-bonus
notes:
Positive-fix fixture for Band of Burning Verdict's (7mmve2l328, REGALIA/ITEM/TAMER accessory) first defect. GeneratedCode/GeneratedMacroCode.php activateCardPrereqs['7mmve2l328:0'] used to wrongly require IsClassBonusActive($player,['TAMER']) AND an Animal/Beast ally already on the field just to legally PLAY this card from hand, even though neither condition is a printed restriction on materializing it -- both belong only to the card's separate '[Class Bonus] [REST]:' activated ability. This fixture deliberately sets up NEITHER: the starting champion is the deck's plain default (no Tamer lineage patch) and no Animal/Beast ally is anywhere on the field, only Band of Burning Verdict itself in hand. Verified live: a single FSM play action (mode=10002, myHand-0!FSM!) succeeds -- the card lands on myField-1 and its On Enter draws a card (deck 3 -> 2, hand 8 -> 7) -- proving the illegal play-block is gone. Fixed via a no-op override of activateCardPrereqs['7mmve2l328:0'] (unconditionally legal) in GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php.

Break/restore verified: with GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GameLogic.php, GrandArchiveSim/Custom/CustomInput.php and GrandArchiveSim/Custom/GeneratedAbilityOverrides.php reverted to their pre-fix (HEAD) content, this fixture's single FSM play action structurally succeeds as a no-op engine response but the step-1 zone_count(myDeck)==2 assertion fails (reports 'got 3') because the old generated prereq rejects the play outright before anything happens; restoring the three files makes it pass again.
